nodes.title: Import only the template dependencies
nodes.why: The template needs the reactive-form directives (formGroup, formControlName, ngSubmit). HttpClient is a service registered with provideHttpClient() in bootstrapApplication, so it does not belong in the component imports, and built-in control flow needs no CommonModule.
nodes.alternative: Import the deprecated HttpClientModule here, or put provideHttpClient() in the component providers, where Angular rejects environment providers with NG0207.
nodes.tradeoff: The HTTP setup sits in src/main.ts, away from the component that uses it, but one registration serves every component and service in the app.

nodes.title: Expose validation before returning
nodes.why: Marking every control as touched reveals the inline errors before submit() returns for an invalid form, including fields the user never focused.
nodes.alternative: Return immediately on an invalid form and leave untouched fields without visible guidance.
nodes.tradeoff: Showing every current error is clearer on submit, though quieter validation can be preferable while the user is still typing.

nodes.title: Own success and error state around the request
nodes.why: Both callbacks clear isSubmitting; only next resets the form, and error keeps the typed values so the user can retry.
nodes.alternative: Set a success message before the request resolves, or leave isSubmitting true after an error.
nodes.tradeoff: Each handler repeats isSubmitting.set(false), but every outcome leaves the button and messages in a known state.

nodes.title: Keep the request state in signals
nodes.why: The next and error callbacks run after submit() has returned. Writing signals there marks the OnPush view for check, so the button label and the messages follow the request.
nodes.alternative: Plain fields assigned in the callbacks, which only reach the screen with default change detection and zone.js.
nodes.tradeoff: The template calls isSubmitting(), successMessage() and errorMessage() instead of reading fields, a small cost for a view that stays correct under OnPush and zoneless change detection.
